# `insert_final_newline`

End the file with a newline, or without one. Not set, the file keeps what it has.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `(not set)`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

## Effect

`true` ends the file with a newline, adding one if it's missing. `false` removes the newline after the last line. With the key unset, the file keeps whether it ends with a newline, as it does in `dotnet format`. A code block can't show the difference.
